name: Palemane Rock
summary: Palemane Rock is a cavern and campsite nestled into the western mountains of Mulgore. It serves as a primary stronghold for the aggressive Palemane gnoll tribe, posing a continual nuisance and threat to the nearby tauren of Bloodhoof Village.

sections.title: A Gnoll Stronghold
sections.body: Situated along the western rim of the grassy plains of Mulgore, Palemane Rock consists of a sprawling open-air encampment fronting a deep, shadowed cavern carved into the mountainside. The Palemane gnolls have claimed both the cave interior and the immediate foothills outside as their territory. Hostile and territorial, these gnolls aggressively defend their den, attacking hunters, travelers, and scouts who wander too close to their rocky haven.

faq.answer: Palemane Rock is a natural cave formation and entrenched gnoll settlement set into the western cliffs of Mulgore.
The cavern and surrounding camp are held by gnolls belonging to the Palemane tribe. They aggressively defend their territory against outsiders, including the native tauren.

faq.q: Why does Palemane Rock matter to the tauren?
faq.answer: The proximity of Palemane Rock to central Mulgore and Bloodhoof Village makes it an active nest of hostile raiders that tauren hunters and braves must continually suppress.

angles.text: The Palemane gnolls entrenched in these western caves are a persistent thorn in the side of your people, threatening game and unwary wanderers across Mulgore's pastures.
Securing Mulgore's borders against local pests like the Palemane gnolls is essential for keeping the tauren homeland safe and stable.
